g.title: work_loop
g.text: The work loop: do the action until its predicate holds; leave the trace; wake

g.title: wake
g.text: cairn wake: one git log of the range since the start record
prints verdict, action or party, reason, predicate
(outside a project, or records ref absent: one line, exit 3)

g.title: waiting
g.text: the agent stops; the hooks print it and do not nag

g.title: reply
g.text: reply SLUG (after ask): append the explanation

g.title: stop
g.text: Done: wake writes the done record;

g.title: actions
g.text: refs/cairn/in-progress is gone; the action finished or was abandoned
a mechanism declares the path, outside: lists it, or a scope record with an ok answer names it
a fix record names the item and a tree that changes no Agreed text; REQ has a current passing receipt at or after it
in-progress names the action, or PATH matches the tree it pinned
the named file reads under its grammar; nothing else changed
a mechanism entry names REQ (cairn declare)
a current receipt carries a result for REQ: input tree, entry digest and text digest equal now
a current receipt carries pass for REQ; the reviewed list carries REQ with a fail receipt
three attempts without a pass: an escalation concerns REQ before a fourth
the reviewed list carries REQ with the current text digest and a fail receipt; no code changed
an outside record names the item, or an escalation concerns it
a review names the current tree and answers every fixed question for every target
cairn brief writes the brief; the agent starts the adversary and waits; a report names the same tree and the brief, with an attempt against every question
a resolution names finding N and the tree after the fix, or an escalation concerns it
the adversary accepts every resolution at the current tree, or rejects one and a new resolution follows; no second report
a realized line in docs/decisions.jsonl names the decision and a tree
a promotion record names a backlog item and a decision; the roadmap section names only Agreed requirements; Current: moved; a start record exists

g.title: escalate
g.text: the next wake says Escalate, then Waiting

g.title: trace
g.text: Leave the trace: a code commit on the branch,
